stemMd:
The instruments that required ______ were moved to a separate room, while the remaining objects stayed in their original cases. The conservators wanted visitors to see the unaffected portion of the collection.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The entire subject is the instruments that required repair. Its verb is were moved, so no punctuation should intervene between subject and predicate.

distractorRationale.b: A comma would separate the complete subject from its verb were moved.
distractorRationale.a: A semicolon cannot divide a subject from its predicate.
distractorRationale.d: A colon cannot separate this subject from the verb completing it.
